approach-person.promptTemplate: {actor} walks toward {recipient} and stops at a comfortable conversational distance.

align-for-conversation.promptTemplate: {actor} turns to face {recipient}, settling into a balanced stance with both hands visible.
engineEffects: align actor facing direction toward recipient

negative-response.promptTemplate: {actor} responds to {recipient} with a sharp dismissive gesture and visibly hostile body language.

positive-response.promptTemplate: {actor} responds calmly to {recipient}, relaxing their shoulders and opening their hands in a constructive gesture.

recipient-negative-reaction.promptTemplate: {recipient} recoils slightly, drawing their arms inward as their expression tightens.

recipient-positive-reaction.promptTemplate: {recipient} maintains eye contact as their posture softens and their expression warms.

spawn-monster-wisp.promptTemplate: A faint indigo wisp appears just above {recipientPossessive} left shoulder.

complete-monster-spawn.promptTemplate: The indigo wisp gathers into the same small smoky-furred Monster, which settles onto {recipientPossessive} left shoulder.
engineEffects: set recipient Monster state to FULL

shrink-monster.promptTemplate: {actorPossessive} shoulder Monster visibly shrinks to half its previous size, its indigo edge dimming as its grip loosens.
engineEffects: set actor Monster state to SMALL

remove-monster.promptTemplate: {actorPossessive} small weakened Monster dissolves into faint indigo wisps and disappears from their shoulder.
engineEffects: set actor Monster state to NONE

transfer-main-focus.promptTemplate: The camera begins following {recipient} as {actor} continues away toward the edge of the frame.

exit-main-frame.promptTemplate: {actor} walks naturally out of the main frame while remaining present in the surrounding world.

promptRules: Resolve placeholders from canonical character data before sending a prompt.
Send one action at a time and wait for its duration before continuing.
Apply engine effects only after the action is accepted or intentionally committed.
Do not include hidden counters, confidence values, or state IDs in Visko prompts.
